paragraphs: Serving Apex families with compassionate, comfortable, and convenient dentistry—helping every member of your family enjoy a healthy, confident smile.
Our experienced team of dental professionals is committed to providing exceptional care with the highest standards of clinical excellence and patient comfort.
Comprehensive dental care for every member of your family. From routine cleanings to advanced treatments, we provide exceptional care with the latest technology and techniques.
Our experienced team of dental professionals is committed to providing exceptional care with the highest standards of clinical excellence and patient comfort.

Riccobene Family Dentistry’s Apex office brings our trusted care to the fast-growing Research Triangle region. Conveniently located off US Highway 64 near the NC-540 interchange, our office is just minutes from downtown Apex and only several miles from nearby Cary, NC.

We are proud to offer compassionate, modern dental care in a welcoming space designed for families. Whether you’re commuting from Cary, Holly Springs, or Feltonville, our Apex location makes it easy to fit high-quality dental visits into your busy life.
We believe in the Riccobene Way - a commitment to deliver better dentistry, better experiences and better results with a comprehensive and compassionate approach.
When you help a lot of people you get to some large numbers that we’re proud of - each satisfied patient is another happy smile.
Can't make it to our Apex office? We have other convenient locations in the area to serve you with the same exceptional dental care.
Quality dental care should be accessible to everyone. We offer flexible payment options, accept most insurance plans, and provide affordable membership plans for uninsured patients.
Save money on dental care with our affordable annual membership plans. No insurance? No problem! Get the care you need at a price you can afford.
Book an appointment online, give us a call, or fill out the form below and we’ll get you scheduled for an appointment.
Patients of all ages are treated at our Apex location, so bring the family to make sure the whole family has a lot to smile about.
Yes, pediatric dental care is offered at our Apex location.

Bring identification and your insurance information with you to your first appointment. If you wear specialized dental or orthodontic equipment, it may be helpful for your dentist to see and ensure fit and functionality.
Our Apex office currently does not offer evening or weekend appointments, operating from 8am - 4pm, Monday through Thursday, and Fridays from 8:00am to 2:00pm..

However, we have locations around the Cary area and may be able to accommodate an evening or weekend appointment at one of our other locations. Give us a call and we can help schedule your appointment at a time and location that works for your needs.

For medical emergencies, dial 911 to seek immediate urgent care. For emergency dental needs, please call our main line at (919) 466-7000. When available, we endeavor to see emergency patients as soon as next-day.
Yes, free parking is available at our Apex office.
Take the first step towards optimal oral health. Contact our Apex office to schedule your appointment or ask any questions about our dental services.
Fill out the form below and we'll get back to you within 24 hours.

Call our Apex Office at 919-466-7000, or use the form below to request an appointment.

Rima H Solanki, DMD

Rima H Solanki, DMD
Dr. Rima Solanki earned her dental degree from the Medical University of South Carolina in 2016 and completed a General Practice Residency at Monmouth Medical Center. Her advanced training includes esthetic dentistry, implants, oral surgery, endodontics, pediatrics, and oral sedation. Passionate about dentistry, she stays current through continuing education and has volunteered on mission trips to Jamaica. A member of the ADA, AGD, AAWD, and NCDS, Dr. Solanki enjoys cooking, traveling, the beach, and time with her husband and young son.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
How do I schedule an appointment at the Apex office?

Book an appointment online, give us a call, or fill out the form below and we’ll get you scheduled for an appointment.

What ages of patients do you treat at the Apex location?

Patients of all ages are treated at our Apex location, so bring the family to make sure the whole family has a lot to smile about.

Does the Apex office offer pediatric dental care?

Yes, pediatric dental care is offered at our Apex location.

What should I bring to my first appointment at the Apex office?

Bring identification and your insurance information with you to your first appointment. If you wear specialized dental or orthodontic equipment, it may be helpful for your dentist to see and ensure fit and functionality.

Does the Apex office have evening or weekend appointments?

Our Apex office currently does not offer evening or weekend appointments, operating from 8am - 4pm, Monday through Thursday, and Fridays from 8:00am to 2:00pm..

However, we have locations around the Cary area and may be able to accommodate an evening or weekend appointment at one of our other locations. Give us a call and we can help schedule your appointment at a time and location that works for your needs.

How does your Apex office handle dental emergencies after hours?

For medical emergencies, dial 911 to seek immediate urgent care. For emergency dental needs, please call our main line at (919) 466-7000. When available, we endeavor to see emergency patients as soon as next-day.

Is free parking available at the Apex office?

Yes, free parking is available at our Apex office.
